name: datafast
description: DataFast is revenue-first web analytics: it shows which traffic sources, campaigns and pages bring paying customers, and an AI assistant can read those numbers for you over MCP. Read-only access you approve and can revoke.
suggestedPrompts: Which traffic sources brought the most revenue in the last 30 days?
How many visitors did my site get last week?
What are my top 10 pages this month?
